ideas.idea: Add groups for the other training crawlers (CCBot, Google-Extended, ClaudeBot, etc.) to match trainingCrawlers: block, and keep AI search bots allowed
ideas.why: geo.config.json declares trainingCrawlers: block but robots.txt only blocks GPTBot, so the policy is only partly enforced.

ideas.idea: Make the root.tsx site-wide description more specific and have every route set its own
ideas.why: The root description is only a fallback, and most routes already set their own, so the effect is small.

ideas.idea: Add Features and Home links to the nav and use <Link> instead of plain <a>
ideas.why: The nav in root.tsx really has no Features link, which would give crawlers a real path to /features. The <Link> part is minor.

ideas.idea: Name the specific integrations in the home page copy instead of 'all the tools you already use'
ideas.why: The home page line is vague, and naming integrations would give people and AI systems concrete facts to read and cite.

ideas.idea: Expand the thin Features page into h2 sections that answer specific questions
ideas.why: features.tsx is a single sentence, so adding real content would help people and machines understand the product.

ideas.idea: Put real plan and price details on the pricing page
ideas.why: pricing.tsx says only 'Talk to us for a quote', so there is nothing concrete to read or cite.

ideas.idea: Add JSON-LD for Organization, SoftwareApplication and Product/Offer
ideas.why: The brief says having no JSON-LD is not a required fix, so recommending it goes against that choice.

ideas.idea: Remove the Disallow for /dashboard so the noindex can be seen
ideas.why: The brief calls the noindex plus disallow on /dashboard correct for a private page, and the report itself says it is harmless.
This is accurate, but lastmod is optional and gives little benefit on a four-URL sitemap.

ideas.idea: Add Open Graph, Twitter and og:image tags
ideas.why: This applies to nearly any site and mainly affects social link previews, not discovery.

ideas.idea: Read the origin from one shared constant instead of hard-coding canonicals
ideas.why: This is a maintainability tidy-up with no effect on how the site is found or read.

ideas.idea: Add an llms.txt so AI crawlers can find key pages
ideas.why: The brief says having no llms.txt is not a problem, and llms.txt does not help crawlers find pages.
